purpose: Teach: 上回る/補給/含み/順次/終える/レギュラー/当店/常時

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期、目標を上回る成果だな。
lines.en: This quarter's results exceeded target. Good work.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Light nod of approval in the voice. No waste — each word lands. Pause before 'good work.' Warm underneath but professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。在庫補給、順次完了しています。
lines.en: Yes. Inventory replenishment is progressing smoothly.
lines.style: Respectful clarity. Steady pace, no stumbling. Not rushed — each detail accounted for. Professional confidence without presumption.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当店ブランドのレギュラー商品、常時欠品させるな。
lines.en: The store-brand regulars need to stay in stock. Never let them go empty.
lines.style: Firm instruction, but not harsh. Light weight on 'never' — this is clear-eyed priority, not fear-based. Eyes-forward, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。新案を含み、年度を終える形で整えます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll incorporate the new ideas and have everything ready by year-end.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slight lean-in feel, meeting the directive head-on. Not promising more than he can deliver — measured reassurance. Small internal breath before 'year-end.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Warm finality. Two words that dismiss and trust in the same breath. Brief, genuine. Small exhale after — mission accepted.
